title: ISBT Kashmiri Gate Underpass Junction
description: High-density vehicle merging point with blind curves and fast transit buses. Frequent pedestrian crossing conflicts during rush hours.
safety_tips: Use the overhead footbridge instead of crossing at grade. Avoid two-wheeler lane changes in the underpass.

title: Old Delhi Railway Stn - Behind G.B. Road Stretch
description: Reported poor streetlight illumination after 9:30 PM with isolated alleys and high risk of bag snatching / harassment.
safety_tips: Take the main metro boulevard route. Avoid solitary walking; travel in groups or book verified pre-paid transit.

title: Minto Bridge Underpass
description: Prone to sudden flash waterlogging up to 3 feet during monsoons and unseasonal storms, causing vehicular submergence.
safety_tips: Bypass via Barakhamba Road or Ranjit Singh flyover during rain warnings.

title: Connaught Place Inner Circle & Palika Police Booth
description: 24/7 CCTV surveillance, pedestrian-only wide corridors, emergency distress kiosks, and continuous police patrolling.
safety_tips: Designated safe waiting zone for late-night taxis and public transit.

title: Mehrauli Badarpur Road - Saket Bottleneck
description: Potholes reported near metro pillar 128, leading to sudden vehicle swerving and motorcycle skidding.
safety_tips: Maintain safe stopping distance and speed below 30 km/h.

title: Milan Subway Underpass
description: High tide storm-water collection hazard. Known for rapid water accumulation during heavy rainfall events.
safety_tips: Use the Milan flyover overhead rather than the subway.

title: Dadar Flower Market Railway Crossing
description: Intense crowd surge between 5:00 AM - 9:00 AM. High pickpocketing reports and slow mobility.
safety_tips: Keep valuables in front pockets or zipped inner compartments. Use elevated railway skywalk.

title: Marine Drive Promenade
description: Fully lit 3.6 km promenade with high tourist presence, continuous beat police, SOS pillars, and scenic safety.
safety_tips: Excellent for late-night strolls and safe solo exploration.

title: Silk Board Junction Flyover Descent
description: Notorious traffic choke-point with abrupt vehicle lane mergers and heavy dust/debris on the left shoulder.
safety_tips: Avoid sudden braking; use the designated outer slip lanes.

title: Koramangala 80 Feet Road (Water Pipeline Trench)
description: Unpaved trenches and missing barricades reported from recent civic utility digging.
safety_tips: Two-wheelers should exercise extreme caution at night.

title: MG Road & Brigade Road Metro Hub
description: Brightly illuminated, high security, tourist help desk at Metro station, and safe pedestrian zones.
safety_tips: Safe pickup zone for app cabs and airport shuttle Vayu Vajra buses.

title: Times Square Pedestrian Plaza
description: 24/7 illuminated plaza with NYPD substation, heavy foot traffic, and high camera coverage.
safety_tips: Beware of costumed photo characters asking for aggressive tips; otherwise very safe and well-lit.

title: Swargate ST Bus Station Merging Chokepoint
description: Heavy intercity bus flow merging abruptly with Shivaji Road city traffic. High pedestrian crossings and blind spots near flyover ramps.
safety_tips: Use the underground pedestrian subway to cross to the bus stand. Avoid sudden vehicle lane swerving.

title: Mutha Riverside Road - Deccan Underpass
description: Prone to sudden water submergence when Khadakwasla dam releases monsoon water into the Mutha river channel.
safety_tips: Bypass via Jangli Maharaj (JM) Road or Karve Road during dam release warnings.

title: FC Road & Goodluck Chowk Safe Corridor
description: Brightly illuminated, wide pedestrian sidewalks with continuous student presence, 24/7 police beat chowky, and CCTV coverage.
safety_tips: Ideal safe corridor for solo walking, late-night tea, and reliable app-cab pickups.
